# Knowledge System

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A system of organization, navigation, and access for knowledge.

## Scope note

- Includes the stages of development described by Jessica Talisman in her book "The Ontology Pipeline".
- Refers to standards for knowledge systems and semantic web with linked data like SKOS, RDF, and OWL.
